summary.tldr: Creates a capital gains tax exemption for certain sales of private corporation shares or Canadian real estate when the proceeds are donated to a qualified donee.
what_it_does: Sets taxable capital gain to zero for certain sales of private corporation shares or Canadian real estate in Canada if the seller donates money from the sale to a qualified donee within 30 days.
Allows a deceased person’s estate to use the same exemption when the person was resident in Canada before death and the estate makes the donation within 30 days of the later sale.
Limits the exempt gain to the part linked to the donated amount, using a formula that also accounts for any advantage received for the gift.
Reverses the exemption if the property, or property based on it, is later acquired again within 60 months, or if a share is redeemed, acquired, or cancelled in that period.
Updates the rules for donated flow-through shares so the new exemption is included with the existing capital gains rules.
summary.background: It amends the Income Tax Act’s capital gains rules. The new exemption applies to certain arm’s length sales of private corporation shares or Canadian real estate.
